videos.title: How To Build The Future: Paul Graham & Amjad Masad
videos.description:
Replit was building toward the AI coding era years before it had a name. In 2024, the company shipped an agent that could take a request in plain English, work through errors, provision its own infrastructure, and keep going until the software actually worked. The model companies even reached out to ask how Replit had pulled it off.

Co-founder and CEO Amjad Masad had been thinking about making programming radically more accessible since 2008, and Replit’s original pitch deck predicted AI-generated code before the Transformer paper was published. Today, that same technology is moving into banks, manufacturers, and other large companies, where Amjad says teams are replacing software projects once scoped at $10 million with $250,000 of Replit.

On How to Build the Future, Paul Graham sits down with Amjad to talk about why Replit was so well positioned when coding agents arrived, what comes after vibe coding, and his bigger vision for the “self-driving company,” where AI agents increasingly build and operate the software a company needs.

videos.title: Is AI Now Good Enough To Cure Cancer? | YC Paper Club
videos.description:
This week’s Paper Club is all about AI for biology. The cost of sequencing has collapsed, which means biology now generates more data than anyone can mine, and the models are finally catching up. We cover how falling sequencing costs are turning cancer care into a per-patient data problem, what it takes to model a cell rather than a molecule, what a language model trained on DNA actually learns, and why in-context learning showed up in a genome model that nobody trained for it.

Chapters:
00:00 - Is the Turing test solved? A live experiment
03:22 - Why now is the best time for AI Bio
08:26 - Alfredo Gonzalez: cancer as a data problem
29:50 - Yusuf Roohani: virtual cells and autonomous research
51:47 - Garyk Brixi: what a model learns from DNA
1:09:57 - Divya Nori: few-shot prompting for biological design

videos.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas: I Ran So Fast for So Long. It Was All I Knew
videos.description:
Holding on tight to everything made Priyanka Chopra Jonas successful. It also wore her out.

In this episode, Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Jay Shetty talk about the day she stopped running. She moved fast for a really long time. She used to feel guilty for taking even one day off. Now she loves being the one who picks her daughter up from school.

Priyanka shares the two questions she asks when her mind starts to spiral. She tells the story of the argument with Nick that changed how they talk. And she opens up about the 110 days after her daughter was born at 27 weeks.

Learn why she says thoughts are not facts. And learn what her daughter told her doll that almost made her cancel a flight.
